thread:
Sofia: Heads up — EuroBank RFP: strict EU-only requirement. They want no US subprocessors (incl analytics), control plane in EU, and BYO-KMS. Need short POC feasibility + 30-day pilot pricing. Can we do a technical stop-gap for presales? cc @Marcus @Priya

Marcus: Quick clarification: when they say 'control plane in EU' do they mean control-plane signaling + logs + metadata? Or just request routing and management UI?

Priya (acct): RFP language: "All telemetry, logs, metadata, and control-plane traffic must remain within EU jurisdiction. No US-based subprocessors may receive telemetry. BYO-KMS mandatory." They prefer VPC peering over IP allowlist for security audit reasons.

Kai: Runtime/ops check: Hosted platform control-plane lives in us-central; data plane can be pinned to eu-west-1. Cloudflare edges may touch EU POPs, but our centralized logging and tracing live in us. For a POC we can disable tracing/logging and remove Sentry, but the control-plane UI and some orchestration signals still transit our control plane in us-central.

Luca (legal): Legally we cannot represent Hosted as EU-control-plane. We can offer an attestation for technical mitigations during a POC (disable telemetry, BYO-KMS, tenant pinning) but contractual guarantee requires Dedicated or Private with EU-local control plane and subprocessors roster.

Marcus: Proposed POC config (technical):
```yaml
tenant_id: eurobank-poc
region_pin: eu-west-1
control_plane_preference: local_only
routing:
  allow_cross_region: false
  failure_mode: reject
telemetry: disabled
byo_kms: true
network: vpc_peering_requested: true
```

Sofia: They explicitly disallow Cloudflare CDN if it routes any telemetry outside EU. Can we route egress via customer-managed egress to avoid Cloudflare for this tenant?

Kai: We can route traffic through customer's VPC via VPC peering and avoid Cloudflare entirely for the tenant. That requires network setup on both sides, and egress IPs will be the customer's. For POC we can do short-lived peering. Ops ETA 3 business days for peering + BYO-KMS connector test.

Priya: Pricing ask: their POC traffic is tiny — 50 reqs/hr, avg 150 tokens. They asked for 30-day pilot price and estimate for Dedicated EU-control-plane (prod).

Luca: For the questionnaire we'll supply: filtered subprocessor list (EU-only), a signed attestation for POC (scope-limited), and a data-flow diagram showing no telemetry to US for POC. I'll draft attestation but call out limitations and what changes are needed for contractual commitments.

Marcus: Subprocessors that would see payload vs metadata for POC: payload (model inputs/outputs) — AWS eu-west-1 (our compute), customer BYO-KMS (eu-west-1). Metadata/telemetry — should be disabled. Any remaining metadata would normally go to our GCP logging (us-central) and Datadog (us), but we'll opt-out those integrations for this tenant.

Sofia: Good. Can ops produce a 1-page runbook for the peering + BYO-KMS steps and a one-line summary for legal attestation? Also need pilot cost delta vs Hosted baseline.

Kai: I'll produce runbook + checklist. Pilot overhead: approx +$1.5k one-time ops setup and +$800/mo ops for manual monitoring + BYO-KMS connector maintenance for small pilot. Dedicated EU-control-plane pricing: ballpark $12k/mo minimum for reserved capacity + provisioning. Will refine after traffic confirmation.

Priya: Customer confirmed they'll start with 30 days and low load. They want the attestation and cost by EOD tomorrow.

Luca: I'll draft attestation and include language: "During the scoped POC, Redwood will disable telemetry, restrict routing to EU compute, and configure BYO-KMS in eu-west-1. This attestation is technical and time-limited; contractual guarantees require Dedicated/Private deployment with EU-local control plane and verified subprocessor roster."

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INF-6072 — "EuroBank EU-only POC: VPC peering + BYO-KMS" assigned to Kai.

Marcus: SE action: I'll upload runbook + config snippet to thread in ~4 hours.

Sofia: Thanks team. Keep comms here so legal can pull language directly. If EuroBank accepts POC attestation we can proceed with peering next week.
